headline: After the Pandemic, a Revolution in Education and Work Awaits
snippet: Providing more Americans with portable health care, portable pensions and opportunities for lifelong learning is what politics needs to be about post-Nov. 3.

headline: Review: A Satire of Social Media That Aims at Too Many Targets
snippet: Michael Breslin and Patrick Foley’s virtual play includes a YouTuber, an influencer and a meme machine. Sometimes total chaos ensues.

headline: It’s Google’s World. We Just Live in It.
snippet: Googling something was all we once did with Google. Now we spend hours a day using its maps, videos, security cameras, email, smartphones and more.

headline: Daily Report: IBM and Yahoo in the Hot Seats
snippet: IBM and Yahoo are in the hot seat this week as both companies seek to rev up their growth. IBM, which reported results on Monday, posted falling sales. Next up is Yahoo.
